Messages.Author: SirTemple
Messages.Body:
Here is a senario that I have encountered:

Ingrid Rossler bleeds with Govern the Unaligned modified by conditioning.
Blocked by Kallinda who plays Disguised Weopen/Ivory Bow.
Ingrid strikes Form of Mist(superior) to continue action
Kalinda plays Psyche(superior) to begin a new combat.
How does this resolve? Please answer this, and also change a few things so I
can better understand the ruling(such as Kalinda striking without agg. damage).

Jason

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <19980204045...@ladder02.news.aol.com>,


Kalinda's strike is largely irrelevant, since Ingrid is ending combat (so
that Kalinda's strike won't resolve whatever it is).

Kalinda's Psyche (or any other effect that would start a new combat) ends
the "continue action" effect from Form of Mist and the new combat starts.

The action remains blocked and is over when combat is over (unless Ingrid
plays another Form of Mist in the new combat or somesuch).
